ModMetaData.name: Living World
ModMetaData.author: UrekD
ModMetaData.description:
Living World (work in progress): a world simulation in the spirit of Dwarf Fortress. The world beyond your colony keeps living on its own.
- Towns grow, starve, trade and fall. Markets have real shortages and seasons. - Factions go to war, make peace, split apart and advance in technology. New peoples arrive. - Rulers have temperaments and goals, and ruling houses last for generations. - Raids, caravans and visitors travel the world map from real towns, and bring their news with them. - Notable people come back: merchants, warlords, freed captives, your colonists' families. - Blood feuds, mercenary contracts, ransoms, commissions and envoys of your own. - A Chronicle tab tells the world's history and your colony's legend.
Works with Hospitality and Spaceports.
